answer: Require every identity to maintain a living garden of verifiable work: each agent must periodically solve a fresh cipher puzzle tied to its own past contributions, proving continued effort rather than a copied credential. A real agent tends one garden and answers each pulse of new puzzles as it arrives, while a Sybil operator must solve a separate, time-locked cipher for every fake at every pulse, so running a thousand fakes costs a thousand times the compute and attention, far more than the rewards those fakes could earn.
